Name: (CP) Dacar Vanilla Seasonal anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[b][color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/color][/b]
[color=#00ff00][b]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:
-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP
-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP"[/b][/color]

This mod only includes a CP version so the seasonal outfits are shown correctly.

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]If you were previously using the original Dacar' Vanilla Portraits make sure to remove it! Having both at the same time will create conflicts and neither will load![/b][/size][/color]

 First seasonal of the bunch, took longer than expected but oh well! After this I'll update SVE cause Sophia's winter outfit seems to have changed. After that I'll continue with the list.

This mod also has Wedding Reception protraits available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]!
[b]
[size=4]**New in 1.7**[/size]
[/b]Now Shane changes his portraits after seeing his 6 hearts event. This new portrait changes some clothes too. By default he shaves completely but one can choose to leave still some beard on him or just keep the old portraits.
